integrity: Analytic proof and finite numerical diagnostics are distinguished. No independent mathematical review or historical priority determination is claimed.
limitations: Only real bounded continuous Bohr almost-periodic radial profiles normalized to supremum norm at most one.
Finite-dimensional Gaussian Fock spaces only; lower-edge discrepancy, not full spectrum or arbitrary measurable profiles.
The exact sharp supremum is not attained in the admissible class.
Historical priority remains subject to possible equivalent formulations in classical heat-semigroup literature.
title: The sharp Berezin–Fredholm lower-edge gap for almost-periodic radial Fock symbols
